## Notes

Genre history: The Sumerian Game adapted into The Sumer Game (Hamurabi); Utopia as the first sim game; genre established in 1989 with SimCity; Caesar began the Impressions historical series; Banished kick-started the survival city-builder trend; Cities: Skylines revived the SimCity style.
